newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: SanMig to buy 49 pct of Indonesian company.
newsitem.headline: SanMig to buy 49 pct of Indonesian company.

text.p: Philippine food and beverage conglomerate San Miguel Corp said on Thursday it had signed an agreement to buy 49 percent of the feeds and poultry business of PT Dharmala Agrifood.

"The alliance of San Miguel and Dharmala will enable both organisations to grow and contribute substantially to the development of the feeds and poultry industries in Indonesia," San Miguel said in a statement.
PT Dharmala is one of the top 10 business groups in Indonesia whose interests include financial services, real estate, agriculture, feed and food, consumer and retail businesses.
San Miguel is the Philippines' leading beer firm which also has interests in food and packaging. it has 12 manufacturing plants in other Asia Pacific countries.
Details of the deal were not disclosed.
The signing of the joint venture agreement has been scheduled for November 22 in one of the Manila's hotels.
